name: Purine (guanine) nucleoside salvage
reason: All three members cover purine/guanine salvage and metabolism.

name: Interferon-stimulated ISG15 antiviral host response
reason: Members cover IFN-alpha/ISG responses, ISGylation and host restriction of viral replication and release. Viral-side regulation terms belong to the same host-virus interface.

name: Nuclear export of mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunits
reason: Members are nucleocytoplasmic export of RNAs and pre-ribosomes. The nucleolar localisation term is closely related.

name: B cell identity and surface signature
reason: All members are B cell surface or identity signatures; the BTM module is described by BCR components such as CD79A.

name: MECP2 transcriptional repression and Rett syndrome mutations
reason: Members are MECP2 functions and the ways mutations disrupt them. HDAC histone deacetylation is the corepressor arm that MECP2 recruits through NCoR/SMRT.

name: Rab-regulated endosomal and secretory membrane trafficking
reason: Members are all vesicle trafficking: endocytosis, endosome maturation, constitutive secretion, Rab GAPs and kinectin-mediated transport. Only a general trafficking name fits.

name: Activity-dependent synaptic plasticity and memory (CaMK-CREB, local translation)
reason: Members cover LTP/LTD, memory, CaMK-CREB and NPAS4 activity-dependent transcription, and synaptic translation control (the CPEB3/ELAVL3 module).

name: Contact activation system: FXII-kallikrein and hereditary angioedema
reason: Members are FXII/kallikrein contact activation, its regulation by C1-inhibitor and its angioedema defects. Amyloid-beta can trigger FXII activation.

name: Central nervous system development and motor behaviour
reason: Most members are CNS development: regional patterning, neurogenesis, neuron fate and migration. A small minority are motor behaviours (walking, righting reflex, motor learning) that read out hindbrain and cerebellar development.

name: Skeletal muscle regeneration and myoblast differentiation
reason: Members cover satellite cell activation, myoblast fusion, myotube differentiation and muscle regeneration.

name: Hair-cell stereocilia and actin-bundled microvilli in hearing/balance
reason: The main sub-theme is hearing and balance: hair cells, stereocilia, otoliths and the vestibular system. The second is microvillus and brush border assembly. They are linked by parallel actin-bundle protrusions, since stereocilia are modified microvilli. Sperm motility is an outlier.

name: Reproductive physiology: copulation and parturition
reason: One sub-theme is male copulatory function (erection, mating, insemination); the other is parturition and uterine contraction. The link is the reproductive physiological axis (oxytocin and smooth muscle), and only a broad reproduction name fits.

name: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
reason: All members are E2F targets, G1/S transcription or cell cycle modules.

name: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport
reason: Members cover disaccharidase digestion, intestinal and renal hexose transporters and their diseases. Lactose synthesis is a related galactose/glucose outlier.

name: Postnatal eye development and hyaloid vessel regression
reason: Members are post-embryonic eye morphogenesis and apoptotic regression of the hyaloid vasculature.

name: Glycolysis and lactate fermentation
reason: Members cover glucose catabolism, PFKFB/F2,6BP control, lactate production and fermentation.

name: Centrosome, spindle orientation and epithelial apicobasal polarity
reason: The majority are centrosome and microtubule nucleation, AURKA/PLK1 and spindle positioning. A minority are epithelial apicobasal polarity and adherens junctions. They are linked because cortical polarity cues (NuMA/LGN) anchor astral microtubules to orient the spindle.

name: Fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation regulation
reason: Members are plasminogen activation, fibrin clot dissolution and fibrinogen levels. Platelet degranulation belongs to the same haemostasis context.

name: Rab GTPase regulation and prenylation in vesicle trafficking
reason: Members cover Rab geranylgeranylation, Rab GEFs/GAPs and Rab signalling, plus the trafficking routes Rabs control.

name: Visual phototransduction and cone opsins
reason: Members are opsins, the phototransduction cascade and its defects, cone development and light detection.

name: Notch and Hedgehog developmental signalling via regulated proteolysis
reason: The main sub-theme is Notch processing and signalling with its oncogenic mutants. The second is Hedgehog: Hh autoprocessing, SMO and GLI processing. They are linked by proteolytic processing and cilium/developmental signalling. Gamma-secretase cleavage of APP and p75NTR, plus the Wnt hallmark, are peripheral.

name: Dendrite arborization and postsynaptic actin remodelling
reason: Members cover dendrite branching, spine morphogenesis, postsynaptic density and actin structure, and structural plasticity.

name: Reelin signalling in dendrite and spine development
reason: Members are Reelin signalling and its effects on dendrites, spines, NMDA receptor clustering and LTP. ApoER2/VLDLR also mediate the amyloid-beta response.

name: Endothelial differentiation and vasculogenesis
reason: Members cover endothelial and arterial differentiation, vasculogenesis, vessel maturation and dorsal aorta formation.

name: Viral/retroelement nuclear entry, integration and host silencing
reason: One sub-theme is HIV pre-integration complex import, integration and APOBEC3G restriction. The other is host silencing of endogenous retroelements (KRAB-ZFP, HUSH, ChAHP). They are linked as host-retroelement genome conflict. The HCMV events and nuclear pore module extend this to viral nuclear life cycles.

name: Skeletal muscle regeneration and myoblast differentiation
reason: Members cover satellite cell activation, myoblast fusion and differentiation, and muscle regeneration.

name: VEGF/Notch-driven venous and lymphatic endothelial specification
reason: Members are endothelial fate commitment, venous and lymphatic differentiation, and the VEGF/neuropilin and Notch signals that specify them.

name: Phosphatidylinositol synthesis and ER-Golgi lipid transfer
reason: Members cover PI synthesis and PITP-mediated PI/PC transfer between membranes.

name: MCT1/basigin proton-coupled lactate transport
reason: All members are monocarboxylate (lactate) transport by SLC16A1 with its chaperone basigin.

name: Microglia/macrophage CSF1R-TREM2 biology and amyloid-beta clearance
reason: The first sub-theme is myeloid biology: CSF1 and DAP12 signalling, microglia, macrophage and osteoclast differentiation and fusion, and efferocytosis. The second is APP and amyloid-beta formation and clearance. They are linked by microglial TREM2/APOE clearance of amyloid in Alzheimer's disease. Axon regeneration and ceramide terms are minority outliers.

name: Epithelial anion transport: SLC4/SLC26/SLC12 and their diseases
reason: Members are bicarbonate, chloride, sulfate, iodide and oxalate transporters and the channelopathies caused by their defects.

name: Ribosome rescue and mRNA surveillance decay
reason: Members cover no-go and non-stop decay and stalled ribosome rescue. Pre-mRNA catabolism is a related RNA decay process.

name: Steroid hormone biosynthesis by CYP enzymes and deficiencies
reason: Members are adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis (pregnenolone, gluco/mineralocorticoid, androgen, estrogen) and their CYP defects. The vitamin metabolism term is a minor outlier.

name: Peptidyl lysine/proline methylation and hydroxylation
reason: The two sub-themes are protein methylation and protein lysyl/prolyl hydroxylation. They are linked as amino acid side-chain PTMs with shared 2-oxoglutarate oxygenase chemistry, but only a general PTM name fits.

name: Shear-stress PIEZO1 mechanotransduction to eNOS-NO-cGMP signalling
reason: Members cover endothelial shear stress and PIEZO1 sensing, eNOS activation and trafficking, BH4, and NO-cGMP signalling. The LYN/LST1 myeloid module and the generic PTM term are minor outliers.

name: Stress granule dynamics in cellular stress response
reason: Members cover stress granule assembly and disassembly, arsenite and PKR stress signalling, and the related PML nuclear bodies.

name: Methionine salvage from methylthioadenosine
reason: Members are methionine metabolism and its salvage pathway. Deoxyribonucleoside catabolism is a related nucleoside-cleavage outlier.

name: Mitochondrial dynamics and mitophagy quality control
reason: Members cover mitochondrial fission and fusion regulation, PINK1-PRKN and receptor-mediated mitophagy, the depolarisation response and RHOT1 (Miro).

name: ESCRT-mediated membrane scission
reason: Members are ESCRT functions: MVB biogenesis, exosomes, viral budding, abscission and nuclear envelope sealing.

name: Acid-base and anion/cation exchange transporters
reason: Members are bicarbonate, chloride and sulfonate exchangers, Na+/H+ exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters and carbonic anhydrase, all serving pH and ion homeostasis. Potassium channels are a minor outlier.
